description: Phase 2 - The Order Saga core. Extend Contracts (add ConfirmOrder command + OrderSubmitted integration event; verify CorrelationId already on ReleaseStock/StockReleased/PaymentCompleted/PaymentFailed). Create the dedicated OrderProcess.Saga host (src/Saga/OrderProcess.Saga, references Contracts ONLY) with OrderState + OrderStateMachine (Submitted->StockReserved->Paid->Confirmed plus the PaymentFailed->ReleaseStock->Cancelled compensation branch), EF saga persistence in its own sagadb + outbox, add POST /orders/{id}/submit and an order-status consumer in Ordering.Api, add the ProcessPayment consumer in Payment.Api with a configurable fail switch, remove Inventory's temporary /test/publish-reserve endpoint, then verify happy path and compensation end-to-end. Depends on FEAT-002 (outbox/inbox wired in every context).
steps: Extend src\Contracts\Commands\Commands.cs with `public record ConfirmOrder(Guid CorrelationId, Guid OrderId);` and src\Contracts\Events\Events.cs with `public record OrderSubmitted(Guid CorrelationId, Guid OrderId, decimal Amount);`. Verify by reading that ReleaseStock/StockReleased/PaymentCompleted/PaymentFailed already carry CorrelationId (they do) - add only if a read shows otherwise. Do not change existing record shapes used by ReserveStockConsumer.

Create src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga as Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web net9.0 minimal host; add to OrderProcess.sln under a new Saga solution folder. ProjectReference: ..\..\Contracts\Contracts.csproj ONLY (bounded-context isolation). Versionless PackageReferences: MassTransit, MassTransit.RabbitMQ, MassTransit.EntityFrameworkCoreIntegration, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design, Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL (add any missing PackageVersion to Directory.Packages.props). appsettings.json: SagaDb connection string (Database=sagadb; Host/Username/Password postgres) + RabbitMq section.

Implement src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\StateMachine\OrderState.cs (SagaStateMachineInstance: CorrelationId, CurrentState, OrderId, Amount, ProductId, Quantity, SubmittedAt/UpdatedAt, RowVersion) and src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\StateMachine\OrderStateMachine.cs: on OrderSubmitted send ReserveStock -> state Submitted; on StockReserved send ProcessPayment -> state StockReserved; on StockReservationFailed finalize as rejected (send a cancel/confirm-reject command the Ordering consumer applies); on PaymentCompleted send ConfirmOrder -> finalize Confirmed; on PaymentFailed COMPENSATE send ReleaseStock -> finalize Cancelled; correlate all events by CorrelationId; SetCompletedWhenFinalized().

Add src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\Context\SagaDbContext.cs mapping OrderState + the outbox entity sets; in Program.cs wire AddMassTransit with AddSagaStateMachine<OrderStateMachine, OrderState>().EntityFrameworkRepository(r => r.ExistingDbContext<SagaDbContext>(); r.UsePostgres()), AddEntityFrameworkOutbox<SagaDbContext>(UsePostgres+UseBusOutbox), UsingRabbitMq(from config)+ConfigureEndpoints. Add migration: dotnet ef migrations add InitialSaga --project src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\OrderProcess.Saga.csproj --startup-project src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\OrderProcess.Saga.csproj; then database update against sagadb.

Ordering.Api: add POST /orders/{id}/submit that loads the order (IOrderRepository.GetByIdAsync), calls Order.Submit(), publishes Contracts.Events.OrderSubmitted(order.Id, order.Id, order.Total) through the Ordering outbox (publish + single SaveChanges). Add src\ordering\Ordering.Api\Consumers\OrderStatusConsumer.cs consuming Contracts.Commands.ConfirmOrder (and the saga's cancel signal) applying Order.Confirm()/Order.Cancel() via the outbox-enlisted DbContext; register the consumer. Use CorrelationId = OrderId convention. Note: OrderStatus enum has no Rejected -> StockReservationFailed terminal path cancels the order (flag to reviewer).

Payment.Api: add src\Payment\Payment.Api\Consumers\ProcessPaymentConsumer.cs consuming Contracts.Commands.ProcessPayment -> write a Payment row via ProcessPaymentHandler/IPaymentRepository and publish Contracts.Events.PaymentCompleted/PaymentFailed through the Payment outbox (atomic). Add a configurable fail switch read from configuration (Payment:FailAmountThreshold; fail when Amount >= threshold, default off) passed to Payment.Process(forceFail) so compensation is deterministic. Register the consumer in AddMassTransit; add the setting to appsettings.json.
Remove the temporary POST /test/publish-reserve endpoint and its unused IPublishEndpoint test wiring from src\Inventory\Inventory.Api\Program.cs; leave the real ReserveStockConsumer path intact.

End-to-end verify: bring up infra, apply all four migrations, start the four hosts in background (non-blocking). HAPPY: seed stock, POST /orders, POST /orders/{id}/submit with amount below the fail threshold -> order Confirmed, stock decremented, Payment Completed, saga finalized. COMPENSATION: create+submit with amount at/above threshold -> PaymentFailed -> ReleaseStock -> stock restored, order Cancelled, saga finalized. Capture ports from launchSettings.json; stop hosts after.
acceptance_criteria: dotnet build d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\OrderProcess.sln -> 0 errors; dotnet sln list shows OrderProcess.Saga.

OrderStateMachine compiles with all Contracts events wired and an explicit PaymentFailed->ReleaseStock compensation branch; InitialSaga migration creates OrderState + outbox tables and applies to sagadb.

Happy path: after POST /orders then POST /orders/{id}/submit (amount below threshold), orderingdb.Orders.Status=Confirmed, inventorydb stock decremented, paymentdb.Payments.Status=Completed, saga instance finalized.

Compensation: with amount at/above threshold, ReleaseStock fires, inventory stock restored to pre-reserve level, orderingdb.Orders.Status=Cancelled, paymentdb.Payments.Status=Failed, saga finalized on the compensation branch.
verification: dotnet build d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\OrderProcess.sln -> 0 errors; dotnet sln list | find OrderProcess.Saga.
dotnet ef migrations add InitialSaga ... then dotnet ef database update ...; psql -d sagadb -c '\dt' shows OrderState + outbox tables.

Run the four hosts; execute the happy-path HTTP calls and query the three business DBs to confirm Confirmed/decremented/Completed + finalized saga; repeat with the fail threshold to confirm Cancelled/restored/Failed + finalized saga. Record exact ports and calls in findings.
findings:
DONE. Build 0 errors/0 warnings; sln lists OrderProcess.Saga; InitialSaga applied to sagadb; HAPPY + COMPENSATION proven end-to-end.

HOST PORTS (from launchSettings.json, http profiles): Ordering.Api http://localhost:5173, Inventory.Api http://localhost:5197, Payment.Api http://localhost:5268, OrderProcess.Saga http://localhost:5280 (new; added Properties/launchSettings.json). Infra per FEAT-001 remap: Postgres localhost:5433, RabbitMQ AMQP localhost:5673, mgmt http://localhost:15673 (guest/guest).

CONTRACTS: Added Contracts.Commands.ConfirmOrder(Guid CorrelationId, Guid OrderId) and Contracts.Commands.CancelOrder(Guid CorrelationId, Guid OrderId, string Reason) (the saga's cancel signal for both the StockReservationFailed terminal path and the PaymentFailed compensation path). VERIFIED CorrelationId already present on ReleaseStock/StockReleased/PaymentCompleted/PaymentFailed (unchanged). OrderSubmitted integration event added as `OrderSubmitted(Guid CorrelationId, Guid OrderId, decimal Amount, Guid ProductId, int Quantity)` — DEVIATION FROM STEP-1 SHAPE: the spec listed `(CorrelationId, OrderId, Amount)` but the saga must issue ReserveStock(ProductId,Quantity), and OrderState needs those fields; carrying them on the (new) OrderSubmitted event is the minimal way to feed the saga without any cross-context reference. No existing record shapes changed.

SAGA HOST (src/Saga/OrderProcess.Saga, Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, references Contracts ONLY): OrderState (CorrelationId PK, CurrentState, OrderId, Amount, ProductId, Quantity, SubmittedAt, UpdatedAt, RowVersion mapped to Postgres xmin). OrderStateMachine flow: Initially(OrderSubmitted)->store+Publish(ReserveStock)->Submitted; During(Submitted): StockReserved->Publish(ProcessPayment)->StockReserved state; StockReservationFailed->Publish(CancelOrder)->Finalize; During(StockReserved): PaymentCompleted->Publish(ConfirmOrder)->Paid->Finalize; PaymentFailed->COMPENSATE Publish(ReleaseStock)+Publish(CancelOrder)->Finalize. SetCompletedWhenFinalized() (finalized instances are deleted => 0 rows after terminal). Correlated by CorrelationId=OrderId everywhere. Used Publish (not Send) for commands: ConfigureEndpoints binds each consumer's queue to the message-type fanout exchange, so Publish routes correctly without explicit endpoint addresses. EF saga persistence via EntityFrameworkRepository(ExistingDbContext<SagaDbContext> + UsePostgres). Added SagaDbContextFactory (IDesignTimeDbContextFactory) so `dotnet ef` works without booting MassTransit/RabbitMQ.

MIGRATION: dotnet ef migrations add InitialSaga --project src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\OrderProcess.Saga.csproj --startup-project (same) => 20261009202821_InitialSaga; dotnet ef database update applied to sagadb. psql \dt shows OrderState + InboxState + OutboxMessage + OutboxState (xmin concurrency column present on OrderState).

ORDERING.API: added POST /orders/{id:guid}/submit (loads order via IOrderRepository, calls Order.Submit(), Publish(OrderSubmitted via first order item's ProductId/Quantity + order.Total) then single SaveChangesAsync => outbox-atomic). Added src/ordering/Ordering.Api/Consumers/OrderStatusConsumer.cs : IConsumer<ConfirmOrder>,IConsumer<CancelOrder> applying Order.Confirm()/Order.Cancel() via the outbox-enlisted DbContext; registered with x.AddConsumer<OrderStatusConsumer>().

PAYMENT.API: added src/Payment/Payment.Api/Consumers/ProcessPaymentConsumer.cs consuming ProcessPayment -> Payment.Create+Process(forceFail) -> Publish(PaymentCompleted|PaymentFailed) + single SaveChanges (outbox-atomic). Fail switch read from configuration Payment:FailAmountThreshold; forceFail = Amount >= threshold. appsettings.json Payment:FailAmountThreshold defaults to "1000". Registered with x.AddConsumer<ProcessPaymentConsumer>().

INVENTORY.API: removed the temporary POST /test/publish-reserve endpoint (and its inline IPublishEndpoint usage). Grep confirms no 'test/publish-reserve' remains.

TWO EXTRA CHANGES REQUIRED to make FEAT-003's own acceptance criteria provable (beyond the literal step list, but mandated by the compensation/stock-restore acceptance + verification):
1) ADDED src/Inventory/Inventory.Api/Consumers/ReleaseStockConsumer.cs : IConsumer<ReleaseStock> (symmetric to ReserveStockConsumer) that calls StockItem.Release(qty) and Publishes StockReleased via the outbox; registered with x.AddConsumer<ReleaseStockConsumer>(). Without it the compensation branch could not restore stock (there was NO ReleaseStock consumer anywhere in the repo).
2) FIXED a PRE-EXISTING Ordering persistence defect: the owned OwnsMany(Order.Items) mapping only persisted Id+OrderId — ProductId/UnitPrice/Quantity (get-only auto-props) were never mapped, so order items saved as all-zero and the saga received ProductId=empty/Quantity=0. Added explicit item.Property(i=>i.ProductId/UnitPrice/Quantity) in OrderingDbContext.OnModelCreating and migration 20261009203438_AddOrderItemColumns (applied to orderingdb). This was latent from before FEAT-003 but blocked the whole flow.

CRITICAL WIRING FIX (root cause of a 'StockReserved received but saga stuck in Submitted' bug, diagnosed via MassTransit docs): FEAT-002 wired only the BUS outbox (AddEntityFrameworkOutbox + UseBusOutbox), which replaces the scoped IPublishEndpoint for ASP.NET request scopes but is NOT applied to consumer/saga RECEIVE endpoints. Consequence: the saga's Publish(ReserveStock) went DIRECT to the broker before the saga state was committed, so the StockReserved reply arrived while the instance was still Initial (not Submitted) and was silently dropped as an unhandled event. FIX: added x.AddConfigureEndpointsCallback((context,name,cfg)=>cfg.UseEntityFrameworkOutbox<TDbContext>(context)) to ALL FOUR hosts (Saga + Ordering + Inventory + Payment). This enables the Consumer Outbox (Inbox+Outbox) per receive endpoint: consumer/saga publishes are now held until state commits (fixing the race) AND the Inbox dedups by MessageId (idempotency for Phase 3). Later features: keep this callback; it is what makes the orchestration correct and idempotent.

EXACT VERIFICATION CALLS (hosts run via Start-Process background, stopped after):
- dotnet build OrderProcess.sln => 0 Error(s) 0 Warning(s); dotnet sln list => src\Saga\OrderProcess.Saga\OrderProcess.Saga.csproj present.
- HAPPY: POST http://localhost:5197/stock {productId:P, availableQuantity:10}; POST http://localhost:5173/orders {customerId, items:[{productId:P, unitPrice:100, quantity:2}]} => orderId O; POST http://localhost:5173/orders/O/submit (Total=200 < 1000). RESULT: orderingdb Orders.Status=Confirmed; inventorydb stock P => Available 8 / Reserved 2 (decremented from 10); paymentdb Payments(O) Amount 200 Status=Completed; sagadb OrderState for O => 0 rows (finalized).
- COMPENSATION: seed stock 10 for product P2; create order with unitPrice=600 quantity=2 (Total=1200 >= 1000 threshold); submit. RESULT: orderingdb Orders.Status=Cancelled; inventorydb stock P2 => Available 10 / Reserved 0 (RESTORED to pre-reserve level via ReleaseStock); paymentdb Payments Amount 1200 Status=Failed; sagadb OrderState => 0 rows (finalized on compensation branch).

REVIEWER FLAGS:
- OrderStatus enum has NO Rejected (= {Draft,Submitted,Confirmed,Cancelled}). Per spec, the StockReservationFailed terminal path CANCELS the order (Order.Cancel()) rather than rejecting it. Both failure branches use the same CancelOrder command/consumer.
- OrderSubmitted event shape extended with ProductId+Quantity (see CONTRACTS above) — deviation from the literal step-1 signature, required for a Contracts-only saga.
- Two scope-adjacent additions (ReleaseStockConsumer; OrderItem column mapping+migration) were necessary to satisfy FEAT-003's own compensation/stock acceptance criteria.
- The AddConfigureEndpointsCallback consumer-outbox wiring was added to all four hosts (completes the Transactional Outbox that FEAT-002 only half-configured).
